raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has streamlined export controls for sound suppressors (silencers), moving certain models from stricter controls to more permissive licensing or License Exception eligibility. For China-based exporters and traders, this signals a narrower but still controlled US market: sound suppressors remain ITAR-controlled under USML Category I for military use, while commercial/sporting models may fall under EAR ECCN 0A501 or 0A502 with reduced licensing friction. Key compliance points: (1) confirm the exact USML/EAR classification of the suppressor model; (2) verify end-user/end-use and screen against BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied party lists; (3) align US HTS 9305.91/9305.99 with Section 301 tariff exposure; (4) ensure no diversion to military or embargoed destinations. This is a US-origin export control change, so China importers of US-origin suppressors must verify re-export authorization and licensing conditions before resale or transfer.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）已简化对消音器（sound suppressors）的出口管制，将部分型号从严格管制调整为更宽松的许可或可适用许可例外。对于中国出口商和贸易商而言，这意味着美国市场虽仍受管制但门槛有所降低：军用消音器仍属ITAR（USML第I类）管制，而商业/运动型型号可能归入EAR ECCN 0A501或0A502，许可阻力减小。关键合规要点：（1）确认消音器型号的USML/EAR准确分类；（2）核实最终用户/最终用途，并筛查BIS实体清单、SDN及被拒绝方名单；（3）将美国HTS 9305.91/9305.99与301关税风险对齐；（4）确保不流向军事或禁运目的地。这是美国原产出口管制变更，中国进口商在转售或转让美国原产消音器前，必须核实再出口授权和许可条件。

checklist.desc: Determine whether the sound suppressor is ITAR USML Category I (military) or EAR ECCN 0A501/0A502 (commercial/sporting); obtain a written classification from the US supplier or BIS.
Screen the US supplier and any intermediate parties against BIS Entity List, OFAC SDN, and denied party lists; obtain end-user and end-use statements.
Map the 10-digit US HTS line (9305.91/9305.99) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
For US-origin suppressors imported into China, verify BIS re-export authorization and license conditions before resale, transfer, or integration into other products.
Confirm the final destination is not an embargoed country or military end-user; maintain records of the streamlined licensing basis and any License Exception used.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms-related components, optics, and accessories into the US market, this reduces some licensing friction but does not remove core obligations: items may still fall under the USML (ITAR) or CCL (EAR) depending on classification, and the rescission does not waive end-user, end-use, or restricted-party screening. Exporters must confirm whether their product is a defense article, a 600-series EAR item, or a purely commercial good, and align US HTS classification with Section 301 tariff exposure. FCC Part 15/18 conformity remains mandatory for any wireless or RF-enabled accessories. Retain full chain-of-custody documentation and be prepared for increased scrutiny of China-origin firearms supply chains.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国市场出口枪支相关零部件、光学器件和配件的中国企业而言，这减少了一部分许可摩擦，但并未免除核心义务：相关物项仍可能根据分类落入USML（ITAR）或CCL（EAR）管辖，且撤销令不免除最终用户、最终用途及受限方筛查要求。出口商须确认其产品属于国防物品、EAR 600系列物项还是纯商业产品，并使美国HTS归类与301关税风险相匹配。任何无线或射频配件仍须符合FCC Part 15/18要求。应保留完整监管链文件，并准备应对对中国原产枪支供应链的更严格审查。

checklist.desc: Determine whether the firearm, part, or accessory is a USML defense article, an EAR 600-series item, or a commercial good; document the classification basis before shipment.
For wireless optics, rangefinders, or smart accessories, verify FCC ID, modular approval, and supplier test reports for US market entry.
Map the 10-digit US HTS line against Section 301 lists, record country of origin and value build-up, and quantify additional duty exposure.
Run restricted-party and denied-person screening; retain end-user and end-use statements and chain-of-custody records for all controlled components.
Confirm compliance with US state chemical restrictions and customer RoHS/REACH contractual clauses for coatings, batteries, and optics.
